description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'EntityConditionValue' which represents base functionality for condition expression values within the Apache OFBiz framework's entity condition package. It includes nested classes and methods for handling SQL value generation, validation, and value retrieval.

classes.name: EntityConditionValue
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for condition expression values, providing core methods for SQL generation, validation, and value retrieval. Contains a nested static class 'ConstantNumberValue' representing a specific constant number condition.

classes.name: ConstantNumberValue
classes.description: A static inner class extending EntityConditionValue, representing a constant numeric value in a condition expression. Implements methods for SQL rendering and value access.

methods.name: constantNumber
methods.description: Factory method to create a ConstantNumberValue instance holding a specified Number.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the model field associated with this value, if any.

methods.name: setModelField
methods.description: Abstract method to assign a model field to this value.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Adds the SQL string representation of this value to the provided StringBuilder, with optional table aliasing.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL representation within the context of a ModelEntity.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the actual value; overloaded to accept either an entity object or delegator and map.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of this value, if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of this condition value.
